remix by {{player|bps|flag=se}} |gametype=1on1, 2on2, FFA |size=Medium |family=[[TB5]] remake |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/aerowalkfrost.bsp }} Cosmetically modified version of '''Aerowalk''', originally created and released by {{player|Preacher|flag=se}} in February 21, 1998. One of five maps in a ''"[[TB5]]-frost"'' map pack intended for release in conjunction with [[Sdcup5]], remixed by {{player|bps|flag=se}}. See also [[dm2frost]], [[dm4frost]], [[dm6frost]] and [[ztndm3frost]]. {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring= |pent= |hp100=1 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=2 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=2 |ng=0 |ssg=0 }} Aerowalk favors a fast, rushed strategical and technical approach, has RA, YA, and Mega control points, and favors utilization of teleporters for shot placement. A special thanks goes out to {{player|Giggler|flag=us}}, who's map [[giggler5]] heavily inspired the original map.
